candidates.headline: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23
candidates.angle: Show Meta funding AI that has literally become the company's boss: the service being paid for now dictates the company while shareholders flee.
candidates.title: AIが社長役
candidates.scene: A boardroom with a single dominant figure: a towering server rack standing at the head of the table wearing a tie. A worried Meta executive clings to the server's base like a child clinging to a parent. Scattered on the floor are tossed share certificates and a small unused lifebuoy lies by the wall.
candidates.reason: 出資の主体と被保護者が逆転する視覚で、AI投資が『負担』になっていることを直感的に示せる。
candidates.visualTurn: role_reversal — the AI (server) occupies the CEO role and the human executive is reduced to a dependent, reversing the usual sponsor/support relationship.
candidates.contradiction: Meta is funding large AI projects but the AI is depicted as the company's boss; the company that should control investment looks subservient while shareholders abandon ship.
candidates.evidence: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23

evaluation.reason: Role-reversal is immediate and reads at small scale: one dominant server-as-CEO and one small human cling to it. That directly inverts the funder/manager relationship implied by the headline (company funds AI, but AI ‘rules’).

candidates.headline: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23
candidates.angle: Make the tiny, early AI component explode in scale into an enormous cost mountain that flattens the company's market standing and raises insurance risk.
candidates.title: 小さなチップが山を作る
candidates.scene: At a cluttered lab bench, a technician taps a tiny AI chip. From that single chip a gigantic mountain of server racks erupts and towers across the scene, casting a shadow that crushes a stunned Meta executive and flattens a downward-pointing market arrow on the floor.
candidates.reason: 『小さな発端が巨大な負担に』というスケールの反転で、開発段階の投資が会社を圧迫する様子を一目で示せる。
candidates.visualTurn: scale_shift — a minute prototype visibly expands into an overwhelming mass of infrastructure that drowns the company and market value.
candidates.contradiction: An incremental technical piece (the tiny chip) is supposed to be small-scale progress, but visually becomes an enormous cost center that overwhelms the firm and spikes risk indicators.
candidates.evidence: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23

evaluation.reason: Scale-shift is a strong ironic device (tiny chip → mountain of servers crushing company and market arrow). The core twist is clear, but the tiny ‘before’ object may be hard to read at 64 mm, reducing clarity and small-format suitability.

candidates.headline: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23
candidates.angle: Turn the idea of 'savings' or 'reserve' into a money-eating machine: the vehicle meant to conserve capital instead devours it to feed AI hardware.
candidates.title: 貯金箱が投資を食べる
candidates.scene: A single large piggy-bank–shaped safe sits center stage. A Meta executive pushes a wheelbarrow piled with coins toward the slot. Instead of storing them, the piggy bank opens a furnace-like maw and gulps the coins, belching up a stack of steaming server racks.
candidates.reason: 貯める／守るはずのオブジェクトが逆に資金を消費するという単純な反転で、投資が『負担』化していることを直感的に表現できる。
candidates.visualTurn: object_inversion — an object expected to preserve value (piggy bank/safe) is revealed to consume and destroy money, converting it into costly AI infrastructure.
candidates.contradiction: A vehicle for saving is shown consuming capital to produce more AI hardware, so the action (depositing money) produces the opposite result (loss of capital and higher burden).
candidates.evidence: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23

evaluation.reason: Object inversion is a clear single-image twist: a piggy-bank (meant to save) literally consumes deposits and turns them into servers. It shows savings/investment becoming a cost rather than protection.

exploredCandidates.contradiction: The world is rushing to 'fix' PHP, yet the actual tools and fixes shown are far too small to stop millions of attack attempts.
exploredCandidates.evidence: 攻撃試行は数百万件に

evaluations.headline: 1. PHP脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ 攻撃試行は数百万件に（ロイター、ロイター経済、ロイター市場等）2026/10/23
evaluations.reason: 強み：見出しは「世界で修正急ぐ」と「攻撃試行は数百万件に」の二点を提示しており、“急ぐ行動”と“圧倒的な規模”という事実上の齟齬がある。案はこの齟齬を直接視覚化しており、世界中の作業が“応急処置”レベルで追いつかない様子が即座に伝わる。弱み：包帯やおもちゃ工具というメタファーはやや使い古された表現で、新奇性は中程度。視覚展開（長い列の技術者対巨大の侵入）は小さなフォーマットでも読めるが、細部の国旗バッジに頼ると縮小時に判別しにくい。visualTurn（描画で読める逆転／前後関係）の説明：修復に「急ぐ」行為が視覚的には大量の攻撃を止めるには明らかに不十分で、助け手の小ささが“急ぐけれど足りない”という逆転（before:世界が急ぐ → after:道具が小さすぎて止められない）を示す。

evaluations.headline: 2. 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃（ロイター、ロイター経済、ロイター市場等）2026/10/23
evaluations.reason: 強み：見出しは『AI投資が市場を押し上げた』ことと『AIへの懸念で急落』という反転を含み、風船が破裂するメタファーは原因と結果の逆転（持ち上げたものが崩壊の原因になる）を直截に表現できる。弱み： ‘‘バブル＝風船’’ のビジュアルは政治・経済風刺で多用されているため、新鮮さは低い。視覚的には一つの明快な関係（AI=風船／投資家=群衆／破裂=暴落）で縮小図でも理解しやすい。visualTurnの説明：AIという持ち上げ要因がそのまま破裂原因に化ける（before:AIで膨らむ期待 → after:AIが弾けて市場を押し流す）。

evaluations.headline: 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23
evaluations.reason: 強み：見出しは『AI投資』が企業にとって本来の“成長エンジン”のはずが『負担』になっている点を示しており、請求書を持つAIという逆転は直接的で強い皮肉になる。弱み：AIを債権者／取り立て屋に擬人化する表現は分かりやすい反面、やや説明的になり得る。小さなコマでCEO・AI・貯金箱の三つだけに絞れば視認性は高い。visualTurnの説明：AIが「利益を作るもの」から「会社に請求を突きつける者」へ逆転する（before:AIに投資して利益を期待 → after:AIが会社の金を吸い上げる請求書を差し出す）。

evaluations.headline: 5. フランスで初のシャモンダウイルスのヒト感染例を確認、感染者は死亡（BBC、時事、yahoo）2026/10/23
evaluations.reason: 強み：見出しが示す『動物間でしかなかったウイルスがヒトに感染し死亡』という境界の崩れを、動物が人間の場面（弔問）を担うことで寓意的に示す案は視覚的に強い印象を与える。弱み：このアイデアは比喩的・寓話的であり、事実の直接的な対立（目的と結果の矛盾）より『境界侵食』を表現するタイプ。やや感傷的に受け取られる可能性があり、文化的・倫理的配慮も必要。visualTurnの説明：本来“人間を見守るはずの人間”が死に、動物が人間の役割を演じることで「動物と人間の境界が逆転した」ことを示す（before:ウイルスは動物領域 → after:ウイルスが人間領域に入り込み、人間の死を招いた）。

evaluations.headline: 1. パリ、暴動と抗議活動で外出禁止令を延長（BBC）2026/10/23
evaluations.reason: 強み：『少数の抗議が都市全体の外出禁止へ』という“不釣り合いさ”を影の拡大で示すメタファーは即効性があり、視覚的に強い。弱み：見出し自体は「暴動と抗議で外出禁止延長」と述べるのみで、抗議の規模が小さいことは明記されていない。提案は“抗議が小さいのに過大な措置が取られた”という前提に依存しており、そこは記事からは裏取りできないため根拠が弱い。このためgroundingを下げる必要がある。visualTurnの説明：実際の抗議者の影が都市全体を覆うことで『小さな行為が巨大な市民制約を生む』という逆転を見せる（before:数人の抗議 → after:都市規模の外出禁止が広がる）。
unsupportedClaims: 抗議者が少数である（見出しは規模について言及していない）

angleCandidates.angle: Make the tiny, early AI component explode in scale into an enormous cost mountain that flattens the company's market standing and raises insurance risk.
angleCandidates.title: 小さなチップが山を作る
angleCandidates.scene: At a cluttered lab bench, a technician taps a tiny AI chip. From that single chip a gigantic mountain of server racks erupts and towers across the scene, casting a shadow that crushes a stunned Meta executive and flattens a downward-pointing market arrow on the floor.
angleCandidates.reason: 『小さな発端が巨大な負担に』というスケールの反転で、開発段階の投資が会社を圧迫する様子を一目で示せる。
angleCandidates.visualTurn: scale_shift — a minute prototype visibly expands into an overwhelming mass of infrastructure that drowns the company and market value.
angleCandidates.contradiction: An incremental technical piece (the tiny chip) is supposed to be small-scale progress, but visually becomes an enormous cost center that overwhelms the firm and spikes risk indicators.

angleEvaluations.reason: Role-reversal is immediate and reads at small scale: one dominant server-as-CEO and one small human cling to it. That directly inverts the funder/manager relationship implied by the headline (company funds AI, but AI ‘rules’).

Object inversion is a clear single-image twist: a piggy-bank (meant to save) literally consumes deposits and turns them into servers. It shows savings/investment becoming a cost rather than protection.

Scale-shift is a strong ironic device (tiny chip → mountain of servers crushing company and market arrow). The core twist is clear, but the tiny ‘before’ object may be hard to read at 64 mm, reducing clarity and small-format suitability.

paperArticleTitle: メタ株6.5％安 AI投資負担懸念
prompt:
Create a single editorial cartoon for English-speaking newspaper readers.
News headline (source evidence, not lettering): 4. メタ株6.5％安、AI投資負担を懸念 CDSも過去最高水準（ロイター経済）2026/10/23
Satirical angle: Show Meta funding AI that has literally become the company's boss: the service being paid for now dictates the company while shareholders flee.
Scene: A boardroom with a single dominant figure: a towering server rack standing at the head of the table wearing a tie. A worried Meta executive clings to the server's base like a child clinging to a parent. Scattered on the floor are tossed share certificates and a small unused lifebuoy lies by the wall.
Visual turn to show in the drawing: role_reversal — the AI (server) occupies the CEO role and the human executive is reduced to a dependent, reversing the usual sponsor/support relationship.
Depict this visible ironic reversal, not a literal reenactment of the reported event or a generic portrait. The turn must read without the title. A metaphor must not assert an unreported action or guilt.
Deliver the illustration alone. The page layout adds its title separately as real text. Do not render any title, subtitle, caption, heading or footer anywhere in this image, including the white margins. Do not write any Japanese characters in the image. Do not add text beneath the figures.
Strongly reference the pen-and-ink editorial cartoon work of Georges Bigot, Charles Wirgman and Charles Keene: observant human caricature, expressive faces and gestures, lively economical contours with deliberate changes in line weight, convincing clothing folds, and sparse hand-drawn hatching. Make these nineteenth-century draughtsmen the primary visual references throughout the drawing.
Create the original artwork for a newspaper illustration that will be printed using letterpress equipment and techniques from 150 years ago, circa 1876. Draw a deliberately composed, human-looking pen-and-ink original for an engraver to turn into a relief printing block. Use economical, clearly separated lines that remain legible when printed at small column size. Deliver the clean original drawing, without simulated aged-paper or printed-ink texture. Specific recognizable characters, expressive caricature, one clear visual joke, spare composition, natural asymmetry, varied purposeful contour lines. Avoid generic AI illustration conventions, glossy perfection, decorative clutter, stock robot imagery unless the joke specifically needs it, and irrelevant objects.
Black ink strokes on pure white paper ONLY. Clear outlines; express every shadow with sparse hatching, cross-hatching or stippled marks. Leave white paper visible between strokes. No gray fills, gradients, smooth shading, color, digital painting, photorealism, artificial paper texture or engraving filter effect. Keep most areas unshaded. Compact square composition, width:height exactly 1:1, complete subjects within the frame.
Design for a small newspaper column only about 64 mm wide. Use one clear visual joke with no more than two main figures and one essential prop. Remove secondary people, inset maps, small labels and ornamental detail. Render exactly one text element in the ENTIRE image: AI. Use bold, clean uppercase English capitals on ONE major prop. Each letter must be at least 15% of the full image height, and the word must occupy at least 30% of the image width. Make the sign physically large in the scene, never a small stamp, badge, chart, screen, speech bubble or distant billboard. If this cannot fit naturally, simplify the prop and composition to make room. No other letters, numbers or pseudo-text anywhere. Ignore ALL label or written-word instructions implicit in the headline, angle and scene except the one specified text element above. Never use fine print or tiny characters. Do NOT draw the Japanese title, a caption, a border, watermark or signature inside the image; the title will be typeset separately outside the artwork. Treat the scene as satire, and do not invent additional factual allegations beyond the supplied headline.
